facts.summary: Rolling NDA started, full submission delayed to 2H 2024 awaiting 12-month data · Phase 2 · avutometinib+defactinib in KRAS mutant LGSOC · not yet approved
facts.indication: recurrent KRAS mutant low-grade serous ovarian cancer

evidence.summary: Plan to complete NDA submission with the mature RAMP 201 dataset, anticipated to include 12 months of follow-up, in the second half of 2024
evidence.safety: The enrollment in RAMP 201 is completed, with 115 patients being treated at the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D)
